content_sections.heading: NABFINS Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Minimum qualification: PUC / 10+2 completed. Must have written, spoken and reading command over the local language (and English, where specified in the state-wise posting). Freshers are eligible to apply. 1-3 years' experience in a similar field job profile, with exposure to field operations working with the target population, is preferable. A valid Driver's License and a motorcycle are mandatory. Graduate in any discipline (10+2+3). Minimum 2 years of experience in sourcing, processing, and servicing Business Loans and Affordable Housing Loans with Banks, NBFCs, MFIs, or Housing Finance Companies (HFCs) is preferred. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Willingness to travel locally for field visits. Knowledge of the local language is mandatory.

faq.question: Q1. What is NABFINS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is the recruitment drive by NABFINS Limited for Customer Service Officer (CSO) - Field Work and Customer Service Executive (CSE) - Individual Business Loans and Housing Loans posts across multiple states.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for all listed CSO and CSE posts is 07 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: For CSO - Field Work, the minimum qualification is PUC/10+2. For CSE - Individual Business Loans and Housing Loans, a graduate degree in any discipline (10+2+3) is required.

faq.answer: Interested candidates can email their resume to [email protected], or to the relevant regional contact listed for their state, before the last date.
